Gomez2024.title: A HITRAN-formatted UV line list of S2-containing transitions involving X3Sigma-g, B3Sigma-u, and Bpp3Piu electronic states
Gomez2024.inspection: Full author manuscript read, including spectroscopy, partition sum and results sections; official numerical states/PF/definition inspected.
Gomez2024.scope: UV X/B/B-double-prime model; author warning above 1500 K. Table maximum 5000 K is availability, not completeness.
Gomez2024.missing_level_note: Te values are quoted by Gomez from Xing 2013. They are potential-minimum separations, not directly adopted lowest-level T0 values. No synthetic singlet correction is added.

ExoMol_distribution.raw_label_conflict: Excited labels B(3Sigma+g) and Bpp(3Pig) disagree with the paper. Raw labels retained; numeric weights and energies unchanged.

ATcT_1.228.note: Rounded displayed values. Do not propagate independent species error bars for this highly correlated atomization reaction. The 10 J/mol change from 1.172 is comparable to display rounding; no significant physical revision is claimed.
ATcT_1.228.paper_inspection: Publisher abstract/metadata only; full text not acquired. Official evaluated tables inspected.

Frederix2009.inspection: Publisher abstract only; full author PDF attempt returned HTTP 403. Consistent evaluated ATcT provenance inspected.

legacy.NASA: Gurvich 1989 part 1 p270, part 2 p165; frozen NASA9 coefficients and heat increments inspected. Original Gurvich pages not acquired.
legacy.JANAF: NIST compiled evaluation 1977; frozen node values inspected.

Barklem_Collet2016.inspection: Frozen CDS partition samples and D0 record used as an alternative source comparison, not independent proof of completeness. The full compilation was not reaudited.
Barklem_Collet2016.role: Its disagreement at 4000 K is retained; no NASA accuracy assumption.

decision.curated: retain current NASA thermal plus ATcT 1.172 balanced D0
decision.reason: The updated balanced energy nearly cancels; the UV list omits low electronic states and has explicit J/v coverage limits. A direct 4000 K replacement is unsupported.
decision.merge_scope: The scoped source review can merge independently of a production replacement or additional original papers.

Fit a derivative-consistent thermal candidate only after those checks, then perform sulfur-conserving finite substitution.
